messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find the dataset titled International Social Survey Programme: Work Orientations IV - ISSP 2015 (Turkey)?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: International Social Survey Programme Work Orientations IV ISSP 2015 Turkey dataset DOI landing page
action.query: International Social Survey Programme Work Orientations IV ISSP 2015 Turkey dataset DOI landing page

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"International Social Survey Programme: Work Orientations IV - ISSP 2015 (Turkey)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.13059","justification":"Exact match for the requested dataset. Published by the GESIS Data Archive in 2018, this dataset is identified by study number ZA5520 (Version 1.0.0). The authors are Ali Çarkoğlu and Ersin Kalaycıoğlu. It contains survey data from 1,535 respondents in Turkey, collected between August 26 and November 15, 2017, covering work orientations, employment conditions, job characteristics, and attitudes toward work. The Turkish dataset is available separately because it was submitted too late for inclusion in the integrated international ISSP 2015 dataset. This DOI leads to the official GESIS dataset record."},{"title":"ISSP 2015 - Work Orientations IV - GESIS Official Documentation","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/issp/data-and-documentation/work-orientations/2015","justification":"Official GESIS documentation page for the ISSP 2015 Work Orientations IV survey. It explicitly confirms that Turkey's data, comprising 1,535 respondents, is available separately under study number ZA5520 rather than in the integrated international dataset. This page provides additional information about survey methodology, participating countries, questionnaires, and data access."}]}
